extract_single_line_metrics: extract key-value metrics from a single line of training log text with type casting
extract_best_line_metrics_higher: find the best training log line by selecting the highest accuracy metric value
extract_best_line_metrics_lower: find the best training log line by selecting the lowest loss metric value
extract_best_line_metrics_thresholds: find the best training log line filtered by minimum and maximum metric threshold constraints
extract_last_line_metrics: extract metrics from the last valid line of multi-line training log output
